prompt_verbatim: One isolated, complete Ultraman Type C sprite, side view facing right, for one frame between the two reference poses. Imagine the hips as a fixed pivot. Compared to reference 1, swing both THIGHS backward toward the left and a LITTLE upward, but stop before the nearly horizontal later position in reference 2. Near knee lies left and distinctly below the hip; far knee lies further left and JUST BELOW the hip. Both legs keep the natural lengths in the reference, lower legs bent left and downward. Upper body, head and both arms remain as in reference 1, abdomen gently supported, without rotating or translating the whole body. Exactly two continuous arms/hands and two legs/feet, preserve red silver suit and blue chest light and proportions. Full figure, no monster, no background or effects, no text, genuine transparent background; clear cohesive 2D pixel art.
